CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem? (1 mark)
   A. Say Journey to Jerusalem has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem.
   C. Use Journey to Jerusalem to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

3. Which response best shows understanding of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Methods of Studying the Holy Bible.
   B. Apply the teaching of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Methods of Studying the Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Methods of Studying the Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul.
   B. Use Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship? (1 mark)
   A. Use Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship to insult classmates of other faiths.

   C. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer.
   B. Say Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

8. Which response best shows understanding of Principles of Good Stewardship? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Principles of Good Stewardship.
   B. Use Principles of Good Stewardship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Principles of Good Stewardship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Principles of Good Stewardship has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Prophet Jeremiah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophet Jeremiah.
   B. Apply the teaching of Prophet Jeremiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Prophet Jeremiah has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Prophet Jeremiah to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem:? (1 mark)
   A. Use Journey to Jerusalem: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem:.
   D. Say Journey to Jerusalem: has no place in daily life.

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

12. Which response best shows understanding of Conquest and settlement in Canaan? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Conquest and settlement in Canaan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Conquest and settlement in Canaan to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Conquest and settlement in Canaan.
   D. Say Conquest and settlement in Canaan has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Journey to Jerusalem and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Journey to Jerusalem Fearless Confession Without Hypocrisy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Journey to Jerusalem and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Journey to Jerusalem The Growth of the Kingdom of God and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
